title: Battle of Gaugamela
summary: Alexander the Great decisively defeated Darius III at Gaugamela, east of the Tigris. Darius fled again and was later killed by his own officers.
reason: After losing the western provinces, Darius raised a vast army in Mesopotamia to stop Alexander's march into the Persian heartland.
significance: It brought down the Achaemenid Empire and opened the way for the Hellenistic world.
